image_description: A close-up view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) featuring a high-gloss reflective surface. The armor has a central vertical ridge, curved lateral edges, and visible attachment points including leather straps with brass rivets on the upper left shoulder area and side lacing holes. The bottom edge features a fauld or waist guard component.
